messages:
Lina: Quick UX check — when I go from Catalog list -> Compare the current search + filters disappear. Users expect their query and selected filters to carry over. Also pin state sometimes resets. Can we preserve context? Sam: saw this in the prototype yesterday, good catch. I think we should keep query + filters in the compare URL so back/forward works. e.g. /compare?q=semantic+search&filters=model:openai,perf:high :+1: Ravi: storing in the URL is fine but watch URL length for big filter sets and long prompt text. We could encode and truncate or fall back to session storage if >2k chars. Jorge: accessibility note — if we navigate to compare view and the list changes, screen readers need an announcement. Suggest aria-live="polite" on the compare results region and a short message like 'Compare view loaded with 3 models, filters preserved.' Sam: +1 on aria-live. Also UX: maintain keyboard focus. If the user had a row focused in the list, focus should land on that model in the compare grid (or first interactive element). Ava: microcopy tweak: when a version is pinned in compare, show a small persistent label 'Pinned version' rather than just an icon tooltip. People miss the pin state when they switch contexts. Ravi: implementation thought — persist two things: (1) url-serializable shallow state (query, filter ids, pinned model ids) (2) full UI state in session storage (expanded rows, sort). That lets deep links work while keeping richer transient state local. Sam: animation idea: when switching views, fade the list into compare and animate the pinned rows moving to the top — helps people understand continuity. Keep motion reduced for users with prefers-reduced-motion. Jorge: for screen reader users we should also announce when pinning/unpinning happens: role="status" message 'Model X pinned to compare'. Don't rely on only visual badge changes. Lina: example copy options — 'Pinned to compare' vs 'Version pinned' vs 'Pinned (compare)'. Which is clearest? My vote: 'Pinned to compare' (explicit). Ava: agree 'Pinned to compare'. Also confirm: pinning from the list should immediately add to compare preview on the right side, not require switching views. That reduces friction for discovery. Ravi: ok engineering next steps: (A) add URL state for query+filters+pins, (B) session storage for heavy UI state, (C) small endpoints for patching pin state so other tabs sync. I'll PR a spike tomorrow. Sam: I'll update the mockups with the label and the reduced-motion variant and add a microcopy doc. Link: https://figma.com/file/xyz/compare-preserve-context (preview) Jorge: I'll draft the aria snippets. Quick example to include in the PR notes: ```
Compare view loaded with 3 models, filters preserved.
Model Codex v2 pinned to compare.
``` Lina: perfect. small QA checklist: preserve query in URL, preserve filter chips, pinned badges are persistent, screen reader announcements, focus landing. Anyone want to add blockers? Sam: none, just will need a quick accessibility review after the PR. Ravi: no blockers, may need help approving API for pin sync. ui-bot: deploy-preview: compare-preserve-context available at https://staging.redwood.dev/compare-preview — snapshot ready :rocket: Lina: thanks all — let's track in the board under UX -> Compare persistence. I'll add the tasks and assign reviewers.
